relations: Aaron — Kayla’s ex and the man she fled; the look-alike in the bar triggers her panic: “I thought I was past this—it’s been a year since the last one.”; “I’m glad I forgave him and didn’t let my past with Aaron ruin it for me.”
Vero — Kayla’s lover: “I am now because you’re here,” I tell him.; “Meeting him was hands down the best thing that has ever happened to me.”; “This is why I love you.”

Doren — Kayla’s bar coworker and friend who grounds her and covers her shift: “You’re a tough bitch, Kayla. You’ll be okay. Did you want me to tell Rogue?”; “Everything seems normal, thanks to Doren not treating me like I’m fragile.”
Bianca — Kayla’s colleague at The Pit who orders her to take a break: “Kayla,” Bianca says, her hand coming down on my shoulder.; “Go out the back and take a break.”
Rogue — someone close to Kayla whom she does not want told about the panic attack: “Did you want me to tell Rogue?”; “Good choice, she would mother-hen you.”

facts.fact: At the bar Kayla sees a man who resembles Aaron and panics, but the man is older than Aaron and is not him
facts.anchor: I see that the man standing there isn’t him; he is older than Aaron, though he looks remarkably similar.

facts.fact: Kayla has a full panic attack and collapses on the crates beside the fire exit
facts.anchor: I make it as far as a stack of crates beside the fire exit before I collapse on one of them and drop my head in my hands.

facts.fact: Doren talks Kayla down with a 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise until she can take a full breath
facts.anchor: Three things I can hear. The music from the bar, the old-ass fridge, and you breathing annoyingly calm.

facts.fact: Kayla repeats the mantra that Aaron is not here and has been in prison for years, talking herself into believing it
facts.anchor: He has been in prison for years.

facts.fact: Doren offers to tell Rogue; Kayla refuses because Rogue would mother-hen her, and Doren agrees to cover her for five minutes
facts.anchor: “Good choice, she would mother-hen you. Stay here for another five and I will cover you.”

facts.fact: Kayla reveals the one childhood fear she cannot shake — the bear hunt song — and that she still does not know how Vero knew about it
facts.anchor: Only that fucking bear hunt song freaks me out, and I still don’t know how Vero even knew about it.

facts.fact: Vero pitches Kayla a paper-cut based business; he quotes Banks rejecting it on liability grounds
facts.anchor: I pitched it to Banks, and he said, and I am quoting him directly, ‘I have concerns about the liability exposure.’

facts.fact: Kayla closes the chapter saying meeting Vero was the best thing that has ever happened to her and that she forgave him
facts.anchor: Though it was a little rocky there for a minute, I’m glad I forgave him and didn’t let my past with Aaron ruin it for me.
